title: Late Night Blue
style: English, jazz ballad, smoky female alto, low and close, grand piano and double bass, soft brush kit, late-night melancholy, warm live-room production, 72 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro]
Two olives in a glass, one toothpick left
Piano man is packing up his book

[Verse 1]
The bar closes in twenty minutes, maybe less
You're the last one in the corner booth
Lipstick on the rim, a napkin folded twice
I know your order better than your name
I keep your tab open like a bad excuse
Brass rail is cold where my elbow sits
The ice melts down to a thin blue line

[Pre-Chorus]
And the streetlamp out front is doing that hum
That says the city's half asleep
Don't ask me to be honest yet
Let the last song finish first

[Chorus]
Late night blue, the kind that doesn't ask for much
Late night blue, just a stool and a slow pour
I'm not lonely, I'm just tired of the truth
Late night blue

[Verse 2]
You took a cab here, you'll take a cab back home
To somebody's kitchen with the lights all on
I'll walk the long way past the old hotel
Where we used to meet when meeting meant something
The doorman nods, he doesn't say a word
He's seen my coat a hundred times
He knows exactly who I'm not waiting for

[Pre-Chorus]
And the streetlamp out front is doing that hum
That says the city's half asleep
Don't ask me to be honest yet
Let the last song finish first

[Chorus]
Late night blue, the kind that doesn't ask for much
Late night blue, just a stool and a slow pour
I'm not lonely, I'm just tired of the truth
Late night blue

[Bridge]
Maybe I'll quit the smoking, maybe not
Maybe love's a thing you do in the morning light
And I've been living in the evening all my life
Pour me one more, then turn the chairs up
Then turn the chairs up

[Verse 3]
The piano man plays two notes on his way out
Doesn't bother with the rest of the tune
The barback stacks the glasses upside down
And the jukebox bleeds a standard in the dark
I fold your napkin into quarters, leave it there

[Outro]
Two olives in a glass, no toothpick now
Bar's closed, but my tab's still open
cover_prompt: smoky jazz bar at closing time, single pendant light, empty stools, deep blue shadow, 9:16 vertical
